title: 6061-T6511 Round Bar: Specs, Sizes, Weights, and What T6511 Actually Means
summary: 6061-T6511 round bar is extruded, stretched for stress relief, and straightened. Minimum 38,000 psi tensile and 35,000 psi yield to ASTM B221. Full size and weight tables, plus what to order.
body_markdown:
### What does 6061-T6511 mean?


It is 6061 aluminum that has been solution heat treated and artificially aged (the T6 part), stress relieved by stretching (the 51), and lightly straightened afterwards (the final 1). It is the standard temper for extruded round bar, flat bar, squares, hexagons and shapes.


### What is the difference between T6510 and T6511?


Only the straightening step. Both are stretched for stress relief. T6510 is not straightened after stretching, T6511 permits minor straightening to meet dimensional tolerances. Mechanical minimums are identical, and most extruded bar in distribution is T6511.


### What is the tensile strength of 6061-T6511?


The specified minimum for extruded 6061-T6 and T6511 is 38,000 psi ultimate tensile with 35,000 psi yield and 17 percent elongation. Cold-finished 6061-T6 and T651 bar carries a higher 42,000 psi ultimate minimum at the same yield, so check which product form your print requires.


### What specification covers 6061-T6511 round bar?


ASTM B221, the standard for aluminum extruded bars, rods, wire, profiles and tubes. Older drawings often reference AMS-QQ-A-200/8, the legacy designation for the same extruded product.


### Can I buy 6061-T6511 round bar cut to length?


Yes. Standard mill stock is 12 foot, and we cut to the length you need so you are not paying for a stick you cannot use. Mill certs with heat number and lot traceability ship with every order, and you get a committed ship date at quote time.
